item.title: WILLIAMS: Week 7 Under the Gold Dome
item.description: Crossover Day is almost here, which means the pace under the Gold Dome has intensified as we work to move Senate legislation to the House before the March 6 deadline.

item.title: MCCLURE: More problems with the revenue office
item.description: Most owners of electric vehicles know or are aware of the Alternative Fuel Tax that they are required to pay every year, on your birthday.

item.title: CHANCEY: Reckless abandon characterizes rock-solid faith in God
item.description: On Oct. 14, 2012, Australian skydiver and extreme sportsman Felix Baumgartner rode a helium balloon-lifted capsule nearly 24 miles into the stratosphere and then stepped out the door and plummeted toward earth.

item.title: Challengers step forward as election qualifying begins
item.description: It’s that time of year again for candidates interested in seeking elected office to officially qualify.

item.title: Tax assessors, chief appraiser meet
item.description: The Baldwin County Board of Tax Assessors met Monday with Chief Tax Appraiser Wade Williams to discuss the upcoming joint meeting with county commissioners.

item.title: Mayor faces backlash over intended proclamation
item.description: Milledgeville Mayor Mary Parham-Copelan is facing flack on social media this week about what was to be a proclamation honoring Scientology founder L. Ron Hubbard.

item.title: Duckworth Hilton pushes forward
item.description: A new five-story hotel with amenities has cleared one hurdle in the quest to become a reality in downtown Milledgeville.

item.title: GRIFFIN: Before escalation in the Middle East, Congress must be engaged
item.description: As a combat veteran and former senior Army officer who has served in harm’s way, including assignments shaped by decisions made at the Pentagon, I understand that military force is sometimes necessary. But, I also understand that war must never be entered into without clarity, consultation and constitutional balance.

item.title: MILLIANS: A Piggly Wiggly romance
item.description: Well, let’s call it what it was: Love at first sight.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Midway proposal right for district
item.description: The Baldwin County Board of Education will likely take a vote on Tuesday on a proposal to merge students at the two Midway Hills schools to form one K-5 school. The vote comes on the heels of two town hall meetings conducted by the BOE for parents to ask questions and share their concerns.
